//: The script modules of every page shell, in load order: the one list app_loader.js, app.js, app_observability.js and tools/build_page_css.py read.
common: loaded first on every page (shared helpers and UI components: add a new app_ui_<name>.js here, after app_dom.js; app_router.js, ns.router, owns the address bar).
pages.<page>.bootstrap: the page controller the shell starts; modules: loaded at start, after common;
lazy.<group>: loaded on first use through ns.loader.loadGroup(group); views.<view> (Observability): a view's modules, loaded when it is first shown.
A module's stylesheet rules ship on a page only when the module is listed for it. Edit this file, then run python3 tools/build_page_css.py:
it copies each page's entry into its shell (<script id="chdashModules">) and rebuilds the page stylesheets.

pages.system (system.html, app_system.js): the System page loads its sections at start: app_system_view.js (the tabs and the shared pieces), app_system_activity.js and app_system_perf.js (parts of the Overview), app_system_overview.js, app_system_queries.js and app_system_disks.js, after the chart engine, the filter bar, the time range picker and the treemap (the Overview's databases).
pages.trace (trace.html, app_trace_page.js): one trace at /observability/traces/<trace id>, a page of its own: the trace view modules of the Traces view without the search ones.

pages.shape (shape.html, app_shape_page.js): one query shape at /system/queries/<hash>, a page of its own: the System view and its Queries section, none of the other sections; app_meta.js gives the highlighter the host's function and keyword lists, as on the Query page.
app_ui_filterbar.js (ns.filterBar): the filter bar of Observability and System, listed on those two pages only (its rules ship where it can be built).
